title: S3.7c local circular ACIS cone projection and distance

scope.geometry: Closest point and unsigned Euclidean distance to the untrimmed circular-cone surface under the local decoded-field parameterization
scope.domain: Finite decoded cone face with ratio exactly 1, positive cosine angle, normalized sine/cosine within caller frame tolerance, nonzero axis and projected major-axis, finite query, and representable reference radius
scope.algorithm: Normalize a temporary cone frame, scale query/origin/radius, solve the closest point on both signed generator lines in the meridian plane, and map the selected nonnegative meridian radius along the query's radial direction
scope.ambiguity_policy: Projection refuses distinct equal-distance meridian results and axial queries whose closest point lies on a nonzero-radius circle; the distance predicate remains available for non-unique minima. An axial query within 16 machine epsilons in scaled axial coordinates of the analytic apex is canonicalized to that apex.
scope.tolerance_policy: Projection uses the caller frame tolerance; distance checks an explicit finite nonnegative linear tolerance, with equality accepted
scope.numeric_policy: Scale local coordinates before solving; construct output coordinates from exponent-scaled products and compensated sums; reject overflowing output atomically
non_claims: elliptic cone projection for ratio other than one
normative ACIS ratio, nappe, orientation, or parameter semantics
edge trims, pcurves, or finite face-domain clipping
B-rep validity, manifoldness, or shell closure
native consumer or independent-kernel semantic qualification
